method: Fixed saved prompt B (49 tokens), 64 generated, greedy; 4 warmup + 5 timed per engine, compaction on, mmap, reader1, slabs16, targets95, ctx2048/batch16/threads4, chunk4 MiB, events2, main decay131072. Sequential engines, OS cache not flushed.
hardware: Windows, Ryzen 9 9950X, RTX 5090 32 GiB, 128 GiB RAM
scope_limits: One repeated short prompt: warm expert-cache locality; not alternating A/B or long-context performance.
Separate sequential engines, adaptive cache capacities and OS state may vary.
Paging counters are machine-wide, not per-process disk reads.
Memory maxima are request-boundary samples, not continuous peaks.
Read timers sum worker time and H2D deltas include prefill; they cannot be added to decode wall time.
No new arithmetic or executable in this experiment; parameter tuning on P5.3c binary.

report.timing: (output tokens - 1) * 1000 / DONE.decode_ms; excludes load/warmup/prefill, includes target sampling, draft, verify, repair and pipe writes
report.scope: saved prompts in round-robin order, sequential engines, OS file cache not cleared
